entities.name: NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: UE state where normal network services are available and UE performs various mobility management procedures.

entities.name: Tracking Area Updating
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE location in the network, including normal, combined, and periodic variants.

entities.name: Paging Response
entities.description: Procedure where UE responds to network paging messages.

entities.name: eCall Inactivity Procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE configured for eCall only mode when specific timers expire.

entities.name: Timer T3411
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: Emergency Bearer Services
entities.description: Condition where UE is attached for emergency services, which exempts it from periodic tracking area updating.

entities.name: eCall Only Mode
entities.description: UE configuration for emergency call services only as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

relations.description: UE in NORMAL-SERVICE state initiates tracking area updating procedures.
UE in NORMAL-SERVICE state responds to paging messages.
Expiry of timer T3411 initiates tracking area updating procedure.
Expiry of timer T3444 triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3445 triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
Emergency bearer services condition exempts UE from periodic tracking area updating.
eCall only mode configuration is required for performing eCall inactivity procedure.
